text_block_list.text: I couldn't even manage to place in the top.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...This is the extent of my power right now.
Where I currently stand."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'm not good enough as I am right now...
Just knowing that much is a gain in itself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Then I just have to run until I reach it.
To do that, I'll simply do what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"The next race has already begun.
As soon as we get back, we're straight into training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I was able to help Admire Vega
switch gears a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't have that option.
Not since the day I made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I'm slow, all I have to do
is keep running until I'm faster.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A quiet yet intense fighting spirit
fills Admire Vega's eyes once more.
It seems I was able to help her out!
